description.short_caption: Erythematous rash with petechiae on the lower extremities.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the lower extremities of a child lying on a white surface. The skin exhibits a widespread erythematous rash with petechial lesions, particularly concentrated on the anterior and lateral aspects of the legs. The petechiae are small, non-blanching, red to purple spots. The child is wearing green shorts, and a green tourniquet is visible on the left leg, suggesting a clinical examination setting.

description.short_caption: Erythematous maculopapular rash on the feet and lower legs.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the dorsal aspect of the feet and lower legs. There is a diffuse, erythematous maculopapular rash visible on the skin. The lesions are small, scattered, and appear slightly raised. The surrounding skin shows no significant swelling or ulceration. The image is well-lit, and the rash distribution is clearly visible.
